body1: ABT Consulting is a Cape Town-based operational efficiency and process improvement consultancy helping small and medium businesses build the operational foundations needed to improve efficiency, protect profitability, and support sustainable growth. Every engagement is tailored to the client's unique environment, combining practical process improvement, clear documentation, and implementation support that delivers lasting results.
body2: Founded on the belief that businesses don't need to work harder—they need better ways of working—ABT Consulting helps organisations create consistent processes, effective systems, and practical operational standards. The result is improved efficiency, greater consistency, and a business that is less dependent on any one individual.
